views.concern: Persisted entities, relationships and report lifecycle data
concern_details: What are the main data entities stored by the system?
How are users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications related to each other?
Which information must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report?
views.reason: The stakeholder picked the data aspect for all three concerns, and the data-model viewpoint frames it. A class diagram shows the entities (users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, notifications), their key attributes and their relationships. It also shows which attributes are kept as a report moves through its states, so one view covers all three concerns.

views.concern: Application parts depending on persisted data
concern_details: Which parts of the application depend on this persisted information?
views.reason: The stakeholder picked the code-structure aspect for this concern, and the module viewpoint frames it. A package diagram shows how the code is divided into modules or layers and which of them depend on the persistence layer and its data. This is a different kind of structure from the entities, so it needs its own view.
